REMOVED FROM JURY TRIAL CALENDAR ON MAR-18-2003 IN DEPT. 220 AS ORDERED BY COURT; UNLAWFUL DETAINER JURY TRIAL RESOLUTION/SETTLEMENT IS REACHED; TERMS OF SETTLEMENT PLACE ON THE RECORD, TO WIT: DEFENDANT MARISOL DAVILA IS TO VACATE PREMISES AT 1436-B CHINOOK ST., SF,CA ON OR BEFORE 5:00PM ON MONDAY, 31MARCH2003 & IS TO RETURN KEY(S) BY 5:00PM; DEF. TO PAY PLNTF. TOTAL OF $8,000.00 MINUS $1,570.00 SEC. DEPOSIT, LEAVING A REMAINING BALANCE OF $6,430.00 TO BE PAID BY DEFENDANT M.DAVILA TO PLNTF. IN TWO EQUAL INSTALLMENTS OF $3,215.00; THE FIRST PAYMENT OF $3,215.00 IS DUE AND PAYABLE BY DEF. M.DAVILA TO PLNTF ON OR BEFORE MARCH 21,2005; THE SECOND INSTALLMENT PAYMENT OF $3,215.00 IS DUE AND PAYABLE BY DEF. M.DAVILA TO PLNTF. ON OR BEFORE MARCH 21,2006; IF EITHER DUE DATE FALLS ON A SATURDAY OR A SUNDAY, THE MONEY PAYMENT IS DUE THE FIRST MONDAY THEREAFTER. IF ALL PAYMENTS ARE MADE BY DEFENDANT MARISOL DAVILA, PLAINTIFF WILL DISMISS THE ACTION; IF DEFENDANT MARISOL DAVILA FAILS TO MAKE PAYMENTS OR FAILS TO VACATE PREMISES, PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY WILL SEEK AND IMMEDIATELY OBTAIN JUDGMENT AGAINST DEFENDANT MARISOL DAVILA FOR RESTITUTION OF PREMISES LISTED ABOVE IN ADDITION TO THE AMOUNTS OF $9,966.00 RENT AND RENT DAMAGES, FOR $2,983.00 ATTORNEY FEES, AND FOR $220.30 IN COSTS AND FOR FORFEITURE OF THE RENTAL AGREEMENT BETWEEN PLNTF. & DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT INFORMS THE COURT ON THE RECORD THAT SHE UNDERSTANDS AND AGREES TO THE TERMS OF THIS SETTLEMENT. PLAINTIFF COUNSEL IS ORDERED TO PREPARE & SUBMIT THE ORDER FOR SIGNATURE. JUDGE: ELLEN CHAITIN; REPORTER: BRENDA FIELDS, CSR; CLERK: MARJORIE MANZELLA (D-220, TUES., 18MAR2003).
